component.name: Convoy
component.summary: Run and review coding agents across projects

description.p: Convoy runs Claude Code and Codex sessions in real terminals, keeps each conversation attached to the project it belongs to, and makes reviewing the result part of the same workflow.

Sessions resume exactly where they left off, worktrees keep parallel work apart, and Files & Changes shows the diff with syntax highlighting and a side-by-side reader. Specifications are revised and approved before tasks are prepared from them, and a finished task moves to review rather than to done — accepting work stays a decision you make.
Agents run with your own permissions and sign in through their own interfaces. Convoy never copies your credentials and never submits a message on your behalf.
